claim: GWAS Catalog rs4613763 association rows preserve a PTGER4 disease-pair allele contrast: the Crohn disease row lists rs4613763-C as the risk allele with OR 1.32, while the multiple-sclerosis row lists rs4613763-G as the risk allele with OR 1.20.
future_grounding_route: Use as a source-specific allele-direction intake record for future harmonized PTGER4 MS/IBD comparison; do not use external rows as project evidence.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: PTGER4 mixed shared/distinct signal closes naive transfer

project_use: Sharper external PTGER4 direction record for V50 reassessment of the project closure of naive MS/IBD transfer at PTGER4.
relationship_note: This directly supports the project's caution that PTGER4 cannot be treated as a simple shared-direction transfer target across MS and Crohn disease.

source.citation: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog association rows for rs4613763 queried through the public REST API.
source.label: GWAS Catalog PTGER4 rs4613763 MS/Crohn association rows

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: GWAS Catalog public API metadata; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not treat API content as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun external GWAS Catalog curation, allele harmonization, or cross-disease PTGER4 comparison in this external layer.
